name: inleaf-reader
description: Stay in flow while reading PDFs in VS Code, with portable AI-ready notes and your choice of AI tools.

commands.title: Inleaf Reader: Set DeepSeek API Key
Inleaf Reader: Clear DeepSeek API Key

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Inleaf Reader
walkthroughs.description: Open a PDF, capture a selection, and choose a translation mode.

steps.title: Open a PDF in the reader
steps.description: Run [Open Paper Reader](command:inleafReader.openReader), or right-click a PDF in the Explorer.

steps.title: Select and annotate
steps.description: Select text in a real-text PDF, then highlight, underline, add a note, translate, or save a word.

steps.title: Check translation setup
steps.description: The dictionary works offline. Run [Diagnose Translation Setup](command:inleafReader.diagnoseTranslation) before using Argos sentence translation.

inleafReader.libreTranslateEndpoint.description: Local LibreTranslate endpoint used by the in-panel translation button.

inleafReader.translationProvider.description: Translation provider. Argos and LibreTranslate can run locally; DeepSeek uses the configured API key from VS Code SecretStorage.

inleafReader.deepSeekModel.description: DeepSeek model used when the translation provider is DeepSeek.

inleafReader.argosPythonPath.description: Optional Python path for local Argos Translate. Empty means .venv-translate/bin/python inside the extension folder.

inleafReader.translationFallbackToLibreT.description: When Argos local translation fails, fall back to the configured LibreTranslate endpoint.

inleafReader.translationSource.description: Source language code used by translation providers that require it.

inleafReader.translationTarget.description: Target language code used by the selected translation provider.

scripts.compile: npm run copy:pdfjs-assets && npm run build:webview && npm run build:extension
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/test-annotation-exports.mjs && node scripts/test-pdf-identity.mjs && node scripts/test-reader-storage.mjs && node scripts/test-ecdict-worker.mjs && node scripts/test-translation-contract.mjs && node scripts/test-webview-worker.mjs && node scripts/test-webview-resilience.mjs && node scripts/test-inline-annotation-editor.mjs && node scripts/test-command-icon.mjs
scripts.check: npm run compile && npm run test:unit && npm run typecheck && node --check media/reader-app.js
